banner.title: Elderly care, connected in real time
banner.subtitle: MediBridge centralizes clinical monitoring, family communication, and care management for nursing homes — giving families peace of mind and caregivers powerful tools.

solution.title: The Problem We Solve
solution.subtitle: Fragmented communication and manual records put elderly patients at risk every day.
solution.problemText: 78.4% of nursing homes in Lima operate with manual records or non-integrated systems. Families depend on phone calls, WhatsApp messages, and in-person visits to learn about their loved one's health — creating chronic uncertainty and delayed emergency response.
solution.operationalText: Caregivers spend 2-3 hours daily on manual record-keeping, reducing direct patient care time. 35% of preventable medical errors in long-term care facilities originate from communication failures during shift changes.
solution.missionText: Design and develop digital health solutions that improve elderly care management through secure, scalable platforms centered on information integration.
solution.visionText: Become the leading startup in software systems for elderly care, standing out for modern architectures and efficient use of technology that scales across care contexts.

profiles.title: Who Is MediBridge For?
profiles.subtitle: Two key segments, one connected ecosystem of care.
profiles.familyText: Direct relatives of elderly residents who need real-time visibility into their loved one's health status, clinical alerts, and direct communication with caregivers — without depending on informal channels.
profiles.caregiverText: Nurses, technicians, and caregivers who need to centralize clinical records, automate medication alerts, and ensure information continuity between shifts — reducing manual workload and human error.

features.title: Platform Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need for safe, efficient, and transparent elderly care.
features.vitalsText: Monitor heart rate, oxygen saturation, blood pressure and more from a centralized dashboard with instant updates.
features.alertsText: Automatic push notifications when vital signs exceed safe thresholds, enabling immediate family and caregiver response.
features.medsText: Inventory tracking, scheduled dose reminders, expiration alerts, and auditable administration logs for full transparency.
features.chatText: Direct messaging within the platform, replacing informal WhatsApp communication with traceable, organized conversations.
features.reportsText: Weekly health summaries with charts, indicators, and downloadable PDF reports for medical consultations.
features.shiftsText: Digital shift change notes ensuring critical information continuity between caregivers, reducing preventable errors.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From registration to real-time monitoring in four simple steps.
howItWorks.step1Text: The nursing home creates an account and adds residents, staff, and family members.
howItWorks.step2Text: Caregivers log vital signs, medications, and daily activities through the mobile app.
howItWorks.step3Text: Families access real-time dashboards, receive alerts, and communicate with staff.
howItWorks.step4Text: Weekly reports and analytics help optimize care plans and prevent complications.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about MediBridge.
faq.q1: How does MediBridge protect patient health data?
faq.a1: MediBridge uses JWT-based authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), and encrypted data storage. All health information is handled under strict confidentiality, integrity, and availability principles aligned with healthcare data regulations.
faq.q2: Do caregivers need technical skills to use the platform?
faq.a2: No. MediBridge is designed for simplicity — frequent tasks like medication logging require a maximum of 3 taps. We also provide on-site and virtual training for care facility staff during onboarding.
faq.q3: Can family members access the platform from abroad?
faq.a3: Yes. MediBridge is a cloud-based platform accessible from any device with internet connection. Families can monitor their loved one's health from anywhere in the world, in real time.
faq.q4: What happens if the internet goes down at the facility?
faq.a4: MediBridge is designed with graceful degradation. Critical data is cached locally and synced automatically when connectivity is restored. No vital information is lost during outages.
faq.q5: Is there a free trial for nursing homes?
faq.a5: Yes. We offer free pilot programs for nursing homes in Lima Metropolitana. Contact us to schedule a demo and start a 30-day trial with full Premium features at no cost.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.introText: Welcome to MediBridge, a digital platform developed by VitalSync for the centralized monitoring and management of elderly care. These Terms and Conditions govern your use of our web and mobile applications. By accessing or using MediBridge, you agree to comply with these terms.
terms.ethicsText: VitalSync adheres to the ethical principles established by the ACM/IEEE Software Engineering Code of Ethics and the Code of Ethics of the Colegio de Ingenieros del Perú (CIP). Our development practices are guided by the following commitments:
terms.ethics1: Act consistently with the public interest, ensuring that our software serves the well-being of elderly patients and their families.
terms.ethics2: Maintain the highest standards of professional competence and integrity in the design, development, and maintenance of our platform.
terms.ethics3: Ensure that our products and modifications meet the highest professional standards, prioritizing patient safety and data confidentiality.
terms.ethics4: Promote an inclusive and respectful environment, ensuring that our platform is accessible to users with varying levels of digital literacy.
terms.dataText: MediBridge handles sensitive clinical data including vital signs, medical records, medication logs, and personal information. We implement the following safeguards:
terms.data1: JWT-based authentication with role-based access control (RBAC) to restrict data access by user role.
terms.data2: Encrypted data storage and transmission using industry-standard protocols.
terms.data3: Audit logging for all critical operations including medication administration and health record modifications.
terms.data4: Compliance with Peruvian data protection regulations (Ley N° 29733, Ley de Protección de Datos Personales).
terms.useText: Users agree to use MediBridge solely for its intended purpose of elderly care monitoring and communication. Prohibited activities include unauthorized access attempts, data manipulation, and use of the platform for any purpose that could harm patients or compromise care quality.

VitalSync is not liable for clinical decisions made solely based on platform data. Users should always consult qualified healthcare professionals for medical decisions.
